Chapter 261: 0258 A Well-Known Show of Nonsense The scene at the Jingcheng book signing made it onto the *Jingcheng Evening News* that same day.

The next day, it appeared in other newspapers and on major web portals.

Iconic scenes like this were always something people loved to talk about, circulating especially within gaming and literary circles.

It was estimated that even ten years from now, people would still bring it up from time to time.

Chen Guiliang then went to Modu for another signing. After returning to Jingcheng, the recording schedules for three television programs were confirmed.

The first to be recorded was *Qiang Qiang San Ren Xing*, followed by CCTV's *Dialogue*.

*The Yang Lan Interviews* would have to wait until after school started, when Yang Lan would come directly to his Beida dorm to record. This was her usual program style—going to the guest's home or workplace rather than filming in a fixed studio.

Jingcheng, Fusheng Building.

This was Phoenix Television's Jingcheng production center.

Before the recording had even begun, Chen Guiliang was already chatting with Dou Wentao and Yan Danchen.

"Is there really no script? You must have a general outline, right?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Dou Wentao said, "There's only a central topic. The rest of the content goes wherever the conversation takes us."

"That's fine," Chen Guiliang said.

Yan Danchen smiled. "If you start talking about outer space, Dou Wentao will pull you back."

Yan Danchen had gained a bit of fame for playing Chang'e in last year's *Lotus Lantern* and had taken on quite a few television series this year. But strangely, she appeared on *Qiang Qiang San Ren Xing* every so often, almost becoming a regular female guest on the show.

Chen Guiliang really wanted to ask what her relationship with Dou Wentao was, but such a question was too presumptuous to voice.

It was the middle of summer. Chen Guiliang wore a T-shirt, and Dou Wentao wore a collared shirt.

Yan Danchen, however, wore a low-cut black blouse underneath, with the collar deliberately designed with lace-like ruffles. On top of that was a retro velvet jacket, and around her neck, she wore a string of pearls. It was the kind of outfit a woman over forty would wear.

Both sexy and elegant, both youthful and mature, a lot of thought must have gone into this ensemble.

After about ten minutes of getting acquainted, the program officially began recording.

Dou Wentao faced the camera and said, "Welcome to *Qiang Qiang San Ren Xing*." He then turned to Chen Guiliang and Yan Danchen. "Ah, Teacher Chen, Danchen, hello."

The title "Teacher Chen" felt strange. Chen Guiliang couldn't help but feel like he had become a master of photography.

He quickly said, "I'm still a student, not a teacher."

"It's just a term of respect. It doesn't have much to do with your profession," Dou Wentao said.

Yan Danchen chimed in, "Last time I was chatting with a guest from Taiwan, they said that in their entertainment industry, everyone started calling each other 'teacher' twenty or thirty years ago."

Dou Wentao said, "Could it have been passed on from there? For a while, we didn't use 'teacher' over here."

Chen Guiliang said, "Probably not. Back in my hometown, people also call everyone 'teacher'."

A mischievous smile suddenly appeared on Dou Wentao's face. "Teacher Chen seemed to have run into some trouble last week? I heard there was an incident at your book signing."

Yan Danchen said, "I read about it in the papers, too. Teacher Chen was cornered at the signing table by over a dozen Jingcheng aunties."

"The police were even called," Dou Wentao added.

Chen Guiliang didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "Don't even mention it. Sometimes you just can't reason with them. Li Xunhuan said that dealing with aunties is more tiring than fighting on a battlefield."

Dou Wentao said, "I know CEO Lu, too. It's rare to see him unable to handle a situation."

Chen Guiliang said, "As long as the matter was resolved, it's fine."

Dou Wentao asked, "How many copies of the new book have been sold?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Between the on-site signings, online pre-sales, and offline sales, the new book has probably sold about 150,000 copies. It might be more, as the numbers haven't been fully tallied yet."

"That's very impressive, over 150,000 in the first week. Definitely a bestseller. Including the previous ones, what's the cumulative sales volume?" Yan Danchen said.

Chen Guiliang said, "Over five million copies."

Dou Wentao genuinely didn't know this and said in surprise, "Whoa!"

That was a cumulative total of over five million copies sold, not five million sets. For example, for the first three books that had been out for a while, if someone bought a set, the sales number would be three copies.

On average, each book sold less than two million copies.

Of course, now that the fourth and fifth books were published, they would also boost the sales of the first three.

Dou Wentao said, "With such high book sales, and you're also running a website and a game company. Teacher Chen must have a lot of fans, right?"

"It's alright," Chen Guiliang said.

Dou Wentao said, "Li Yuchun's fans are called 'Corns.' What are your fans called?"

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Take a guess."

Yan Danchen said, "It can't be 'Liangfen,' that's Zhang Liangying's fan name. It wouldn't be 'Guipi,' would it?"

Dou Wentao said, "I'll guess 'Guiyuan.'"

Chen Guiliang said, "Ether."

"Huh?" Yan Danchen didn't understand.

Chen Guiliang sighed. "I don't know who gave me the nickname 'Chen Shiyi.' Those fans just started goofing around and began calling themselves 'Ether.' Ether is pretty good at knocking people out."

Dou Wentao really didn't have a script prepared; the topic jumped around erratically. "Danchen is pretty good at knocking people out today, too. Why are you dressed like a socialite? You've completely stunned me."

Yan Danchen said, "Well, a big boss was coming today. So I specifically picked this out. Since we're both guests, I thought it wouldn't be good to appear on screen without dressing up a bit."

Dou Wentao laughed. "And as it turns out, Teacher Chen shows up in a T-shirt and jeans. He's dressed like a university student, and you're dressed like a university student's teacher."

Chen Guiliang immediately said, "Hello, Teacher Yan."

"I wouldn't dare," Yan Danchen laughed as well. "I wish I could be a teacher at Beida, but unfortunately, I didn't study hard enough back then."

Dou Wentao was constantly steering the conversation. "Speaking of university students. Teacher Chen, at school, are you any different from a regular student? Do you get surrounded by people?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Olympic champion Liu Xuan doesn't even get surrounded, and my fame is far less than hers. But there are always people who joke with me, like putting extra locks on my bicycle."

"You still ride a bicycle?" Yan Danchen asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "My company isn't far from the east gate of the university, so I can't exactly drive to and from work on campus. During my freshman year, I bought a second-hand bike for 60 yuan, but it was stolen not long after. I bought another one later and put five locks on it. Last semester, someone added more until there were eight, calling it some 'Eight Gates Golden Lock Formation.'"

Yan Danchen smiled. "Your ride must get a lot of looks at school then."

Chen Guiliang boasted, "That's for sure. It just takes a lot of time to lock and unlock. This bicycle of mine is very high in academic content; it has carried quite a few giants from academia. These old professors are at an age where they're wobbly on their feet, but they sit quite steadily on my bike."

"Like who?" Yan Danchen asked curiously.

Chen Guiliang gave an example, "Like Professor Yuan, the chief editor of the newest edition of the high school Chinese textbook. Old Mr. Yuan is 70 this year, and whenever I run into him at school, I give him a ride on my bike."

Dou Wentao commented, "One dares to sit, and the other dares to ride. Neither is afraid of an accident."

"I was always scared of my teachers when I was a student. I really envy how well you get along with yours," Yan Danchen said.

Chen Guiliang said, "You just have to be shameless. If you don't treat your teachers like strangers, they won't treat you like one either."

Dou Wentao said, "I just remembered something. You once questioned an error in the annotations for the *Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng*, and when the new edition of the textbook came out last year, the annotation for that essay was actually changed. At the time, some media outlets said it was related to you? And now you're saying that the chief editor of the new high school Chinese textbook often rides on your bicycle."

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Let's not discuss this topic."

Dou Wentao understood. "Got it, we can't elaborate on that. Then let's talk about something we can. Danchen, have you ever played *Sanguosha*?"

Yan Danchen said, "I'd heard a little about it before, but I'd never played. This time, knowing I'd be on the show with CEO Chen, I crammed in a session yesterday. I played from after dinner all the way until two in the morning."

Dou Wentao pointed at Chen Guiliang and joked, "And you say your game isn't addictive? Danchen has almost become an internet-addicted young madam."

Chen Guiliang said, "Isn't it 'internet-addicted young lady'?"

Dou Wentao grinned a little lewdly. "With her outfit today, she can only be called an internet-addicted socialite."

Yan Danchen quickly changed the subject back. "I think *Sanguosha* is very fun, suitable for people like us who don't have much time to play games."

Once Dou Wentao started with the suggestive jokes, he couldn't stop for a moment, and it made him think of something else. "Before doing this episode, I did some research online. I heard that because players weren't paying, Teacher Chen invented a term called 'báipiáo dǎng'?"

Chen Guiliang nodded. "You play but don't pay. What else would you call it but freeloading?"

"Very vivid," Dou Wentao laughed. "The internet advocates a spirit of sharing, and everywhere you look, there are freeloaders. I've never paid for anything I download, so I guess that makes me a freeloader too."
